raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 24
, Reason for Mistake: In the “New plan,” the Orchestrator dropped the requirement to confirm each hike was recommended by at least three different people with kids and focused only on pulling hikes from a single family blog and checking TripAdvisor ratings. This planning error misaligned the workflow with the user’s constraints and later allowed inclusion of Wraith Falls despite WebSurfer finding it had only 4/5 with 44 reviews, leading to the incorrect final shortlist.
